record.original_question: Determine the limits lim_{n→∞} cr̄(K_n)/n^4 and lim_{n→∞} cr̄(K_n)/cr(K_n), where cr̄(K_n) denotes the geometrical (rectilinear) crossing number of K_n and cr(K_n) is the ordinary crossing number.

evidence.quote: Problem 2.5 Find limn→∞ cr(Kn )/n4 and limn→∞ cr(Kn )/cr(Kn ).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K_n$ denote the complete graph on $n$ vertices. The (ordinary) crossing number $\operatorname{cr}(K_n)$ is the minimum number of pairwise crossings of edges, taken over all drawings of $K_n$ in the plane in which vertices are distinct points and edges are simple curves joining their endpoints, with the property that no three edges meet at a common interior point and any two edges share at most one point. The rectilinear (geometric) crossing number $\overline{\operatorname{cr}}(K_n)$ is defined analogously, but only drawings in which every edge is a straight-line segment are allowed (so the $n$ vertices are placed as points in general position in the plane and edges are the $\binom{n}{2}$ line segments joining them).

Determine the two limits
$$\lim_{n\to\infty} \frac{\overline{\operatorname{cr}}(K_n)}{n^4} \qquad\text{and}\qquad \lim_{n\to\infty} \frac{\overline{\operatorname{cr}}(K_n)}{\operatorname{cr}(K_n)}.$$
(Equivalently, since $\operatorname{cr}(K_n)/\binom{n}{4}$ is known to tend to a constant, determine the rectilinear crossing constant $\nu^* := \lim_{n\to\infty} \overline{\operatorname{cr}}(K_n)/\binom{n}{4}$ and the ratio of the two asymptotic constants.)
artifact.status_search_result: The exact value of the rectilinear crossing constant $\lim_n \overline{\operatorname{cr}}(K_n)/\binom{n}{4}$ is a well-known open problem; the current best bounds are roughly $0.379972 \le \nu^* \le 0.380473$ (due to Ábrego et al. and Fabila-Monroy–López). The ordinary crossing constant is also not known exactly (Guy's conjecture gives the conjectured value $3/8$ for the upper limit), so the limit of the ratio $\overline{\operatorname{cr}}(K_n)/\operatorname{cr}(K_n)$ is likewise open.

status_evidence.title: The Rectilinear Crossing Number of K_n: Closing in (or Are We?)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey describing the rectilinear crossing constant and current best bounds; finding its exact value remains open.
status_evidence.claim: The exact value of the rectilinear crossing constant remains unknown; best bounds are approximately 0.379972 ≤ ν* ≤ 0.380473.

status_evidence.claim: Both cr(K_n) and the rectilinear crossing number of K_n are not known in closed form for general n.
